counts.actionCountDefinition: 1 repeated component-selection template + 2 fatal retry templates + 2 retained refresh templates + 1 review-details + 1 drawer dismissal = 7. Fatal/retained retry templates collapse to one behavior per source: select, board retry, detail retry, review, close = 5. Number of rendered selection buttons is payload components.length, not a fixed five; configured backend currently builds five component specs. Header subtitle-help is an additional shared action. Conditional branches are not simultaneously counted as rendered controls.

numericSupportAndProvenance.wireUnits: useRUL.ts:35-38 and dtos.go:22-36 return remaining_km in kilometres and remaining_days in days (legacy endpoint, not SI metre/second fields). numericSupportAndProvenance.preferences: useUnits.ts:118-147 derives distance/locale/precision from settings and delegates; useNumberFormatting.ts:20-45 subscribes live formatter preferences. Health and projected numbers use formatters; explicit distance precision0 is a specialist override, candidate C-03 rather than assumed defect. RUL-05 records unformatted dates/confidence digits.
numericSupportAndProvenance.denominators: prognostics.go:266-296 reconstructs SoH from separate daily energy and SOC maxima divided by estimated nominalWh, not a direct measured component lifespan. WearRUL:376-416 uses configured nominal km minus whole-life odometer, divided by recent km/day; no per-service reset. AgeRUL:423-460 uses nominal calendar days minus time since enrollment, fixed confidence0.6; no replacement history. Detail DTO includes nullable nominal_life_km/nominal_life_days/eol_threshold and notes; handler.go:382-389 returns them. Page plots EOL and retains basis/notes but does not explicitly display nominal-life fields or wear_rate_per_day. Missing battery nominal capacity/method/observation counts/timestamps are not proved DTO capabilities.
numericSupportAndProvenance.predictionNotObservation: Page labels projected health/forecast/band; NextServiceBrief:32 says not guaranteed failure date; board/detail states use inferred provenance (page:74,91). No observed-lifespan series exists in this contract. Fetch dataUpdatedAt is successful retrieval time, not source observation. Backend fallback semantics create RUL-02.
numericSupportAndProvenance.physicalSigns: No numeric abs() or sign-flipping conversion in page/hook. Backend intentionally bounds life/health and overdue remaining time/distance at zero (prognostics.go:396-406,453-455). Page does not independently erase an observed signed physical reading. Invalid/null numerical payload behavior remains C-01, not an invented incident.
